Vendored UI skills. Each SKILL.md gained `disable-model-invocation: true` so it loads when named and does not restyle Lunaria on its own. frontend-design also has a one-line Apache notice under the frontmatter.

- frontend-design: anthropics/skills, Apache-2.0. License text is frontend-design/LICENSE.txt.
- web-design-guidelines: vercel-labs/agent-skills. The repository README states MIT and does not ship a LICENSE file.
- emil-design-eng, review-animations, animation-performance, break-ui: emilkowalski/skills, MIT. License text is vendor/emilkowalski-skills-LICENSE.
